proposals.defect: The pool is always shut down with wait=True, so after a timeout the caller blocks until the timed-out attempt finishes. It does not stop waiting on the slow route, so fallback or the timeout error is delayed.
A zero timeout is treated as no timeout because of a falsy check instead of an is-None check. A route with timeout_seconds == 0 runs unbounded and never times out or falls back.
